answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 12 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in saffron, queued in wander, and ridge publishes the wait time. A farm of 211 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3812 identities would post 3464 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
